title: LIVE CONFIRMATION: Taildrive WebDAV symlink escape reproduced on real tailscaled across two nodes
setup: Sharer = tkm (tailscale 1.104.1, this laptop); Reader = pi5 (Raspberry Pi 5, tailscale 1.102.2). Same tailnet tail7ebeb8.ts.net. Share 'poc' = /tmp/td-poc/share containing symlinks pointing OUTSIDE the share root.

results.link_to_secret -> /tmp/td-poc/secret/sec: SECRET-OUTSIDE-SHARE 1792939863 — ... the share boundary was escaped

conclusion: A tailnet peer granted Taildrive access read files outside the shared directory root via symlinks inside the share. End-to-end confirmation of the webdav.Dir symlink-follow finding (ev10) on real tailscaled, not just the library-level PoC.
notes: AllowedIPs/permission model otherwise intact; read performed as the sharing user (tkmremi). Matches the source-traced path peerapi /v0/drive -> webdav.Dir.OpenFile.
